summary: Space Invaders entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Space Invaders

emulation.notes: Use original display/difficulty settings when possible.

primary.why: Hamster's Arcade Archives release of Space Invaders, Taito's 1978 shooting game, covers current platforms, alongside the arcade original and legacy ports. Arcade Archives is the cleanest official modern route for the original arcade game.
primary.how_to_play: Play Arcade Archives SPACE INVADERS using the original arcade display/settings options. Use a real cabinet only for hardware comparison and Invincible Collection only for wider franchise sampling.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Taito arcade hardware and the content authority for the game.
all_releases.reason: skip: historically authoritative, but modern Arcade Archives is easier to capture and preserve.

all_releases.platform: Atari 2600 / Atari 8-bit / Atari 5200 and other legacy ports
all_releases.fidelity: Major early home conversions with hardware-specific differences.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced exclusive content requires replay for the arcade-entry recommendation.

all_releases.fidelity: Large Switch collection with the original 1978 game plus sequel/spinoff titles.
all_releases.reason: skip: great franchise context, but Arcade Archives is the focused primary for the single 1978 entry.

all_releases.fidelity: Official modern arcade reproduction for Switch/Switch 2, PS4/PS5, and Xbox Series hardware.
all_releases.reason: primary: best current official route for the original arcade version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced exclusive-content split requires a secondary route for this archive entry.

entries.remaster_caveats: Invincible Collection is broader franchise context; for the standalone 1978 game, Arcade Archives is the more direct route.
